reviewer.tool: captured PNG evidence and numeric Debug readback; local Symphony vision disabled

observations: The generated material-semantics fixture loads and renders all ten probe spheres plus the mirrored sphere; the Debug material records match the authored base colour, metallic, roughness, alpha mode, transmission and IOR values.

The import-isolation lane proves normalTexture.scale 0/0.45/1, independent occlusion in dependency slot 4, per-slot UV set/sampler/transform, the UV1 unsupported record, MASK cutoff and IOR=1 suppression without any GPU dependence.
The IOR=1 crew-suit pattern now emits the explicit suppression compatibility record instead of silently dropping transmission; the OPAQUE alpha mode is preserved rather than rewritten to BLEND.

The GPU shading application of normalTexture.scale, per-slot texture transforms and the independent occlusion map is NOT applied by this slice: the renderer-side CBV/root-signature change was reverted after it produced a reproducible textured-draw hang on this workstation. The wire, validator, importer, compatibility and cache work is landed and tested.

Car, Camera, Suit and microscope captures were re-run with the T21-equivalent render path; Camera glass remains a reviewed nonregression case (dark lens with reflection depth). Car glass ordering and microscope ResourceLimit remain T26/T27 and T23.

defects.label: limitation
defects.description: Normal scale, per-slot transforms and the independent occlusion texture are carried and validated on the wire but the GPU shader still uses the T21 material path (MR red as AO). The attempted b3 CBV/root-signature integration hung every textured load and was reverted to keep the tree working.

defects.label: reviewed-nonregression
defects.description: Camera lens remains dark with visible reflection depth; no regression from the material-record changes.

positives: Wire protocol v13, MaterialPayload 244 bytes, five material image slots and eight dependency slots are validated at the trust boundary.
The glTF importer preserves authored normal scale, per-texture UV set/sampler/transform metadata, independent occlusion, alpha mode/cutoff, transmission and unlit semantics.
Derived-cache keys now default to the real protocol/importer/material/vertex-layout identity.
UV1 references are left unbound with a specific compatibility record; MR red is no longer treated as authored AO in the normalized data.

acceptance.acceptedReferencesPromotedBy: not applicable for T22 (observed evidence only)
acceptance.note: T22 is a partial slice: authored-input preservation is landed and tested; the GPU shading application remains open.
